capabilities.description: Keeps what you watch in step with Pastime.

global_config_schema.title: Pastime server
global_config_schema.description: Where Silo sends what connected profiles watch.

fields.label: Pastime address
fields.description: The address people open Pastime at, for example https://pastime.example.com.

presentation.summary: Sends playback, history, favourites, watchlist and ratings to Pastime, and brings in what you watched elsewhere.
presentation.description_markdown: Sends what each connected profile watches to Pastime: live playback, finished plays, favourites, watchlist and ratings. Pastime favourites, watchlist and ratings are added to Silo, and so are plays and resume points Pastime recorded from other sources; plays Silo sent are never read back. A Pastime read never removes anything from Silo.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Install the plugin and set **Pastime address** to the address people open Pastime at.
2. Each person opens Pastime's **Connect Silo** page, creates a key for their Pastime profile, then in Silo switches to that profile, opens **Settings → Watch Providers**, chooses **Pastime** and pastes the key.

A new key replaces the profile's previous one. Disconnecting in Silo stops sending; revoking the key in Pastime does too.
